content.text: Hi everyone, apologies for the late text message, but just heard from Rob Butcher, the Reds PR director, and Nick Castellanos will be doing a zoom session with the Cincinnati writers tomorrow around 2:30-3 pm to talk about Opening Day. If you're interested in participating in that, please let me know and I will pass along your email to Rob so you receive the zoom link.
